exp.desc:
- Programming and gym floor
- 60+ back and knee programme (fully booked)
- Classes: functional training, back care

cl.p1: many of our members are over sixty and come in with back or knee problems. I developed a small-group programme for them that is now fully booked every evening.
cl.p2: I hold a recognised personal training qualification and an exercise referral certificate, and I have worked on the gym floor and in classes for five years. Your club works closely with physiotherapists, and I would like to learn from them.

letters.label: Qualified instructor with a health focus

cl.p1: on Tuesday and Thursday evenings and on Sundays I could cover gym floor shifts. Sports science is my degree subject, now in year two, and I have trained for six years myself.
cl.p2: I already write beginner programmes for friends and classmates and completed a gym instructor course this summer.
